name: TCGBench
description: TCGBench is a benchmark developed to facilitate the study of test-case generation (TCG) for code generation evaluation. It includes multi-dimensional metrics to quantify test-suite thoroughness and supports evaluation of human-LLM collaborative methods to improve test coverage and quality.
reputation: A specialized benchmark for test-case generation in code evaluation that is useful in research settings but not yet broadly adopted as a standard benchmark.
notes: Addresses limitations of existing code generation benchmarks; introduces human-LLM collaborative method SAGA; improves detection rate and verifier accuracy.
